Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.

Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.

Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability.
Repeat.

4210-4279-6887--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-4279-6887--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, The Skullspore Nexus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus ability, creating a X/X Fungus creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

654-1308-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.

1017-3532-5078-7913.description:

1479-5700-5701-6664-7889.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6664-7889.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4067-6254-6827-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.

261-3375-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

703-5400-7149.description:
Cast Synth Infiltrator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Synth Infiltrator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Synth Infiltrator dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Synth Infiltrators into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Synth Infiltrator tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-5400-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wormfang Drake and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.

When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.

When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.

Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.

If the noncreature artifact has a mana value of zero, this combo nets infinite mana, which would allow you to instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
